description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Operations Intelligence product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Daily Business Intelligence).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Operations Intelligence.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Operations Intelligence. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.5 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
